name: Banh mi op la
summary: Bánh mì ốp la is a fried egg with bread, the breakfast on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng.
origin: The Da Nang breakfast street, as its own line from the filled bánh mì.
howToEat: Eat it in the morning on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng.
where: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, in the morning. One account says the street is crowded from 06:00 to 08:00. The 2019 account prints 06:00–12:00.
seoTitle: Banh mi op la — fried egg on the breakfast street
seoDescription: Bánh mì ốp la is a fried egg with bread, the breakfast on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng.
